stdout:
# Checkpoint

Task: add canonical OS EOL lookup, per-target scan warnings, summary rendering, and shared major-version parsing.

## Investigation

- `scan.GetScanResults` copied each target's scan model into results without any EOL evaluation.
- `report.formatScanSummary` rendered a warnings slice as one Go value, so individual warning text and order were not represented with the required prefix.
- EOL mappings did not exist. Major extraction was duplicated in `config`, `oval`, and `gost`; the `oval` parser assumed a dot and could panic for dotless versions.
- OS detection yields patch releases (`7.9`, `11.4-RELEASE`, `18.04.6`) while requested lifecycle keys use major or major.minor versions. Amazon uses its own release keys.
- Failing reproductions were run before fixes: `GOPROXY=off go test ./config -run TestEOLLookupAndBoundaries -count=1` failed on undefined `GetEOL`; `GOPROXY=off go test ./scan -run TestAppendEOLWarningsNormalizesDetectedRelease -count=1` returned missing-mapping warnings for detected patch releases; `GOPROXY=off go test ./config -run TestAmazonMajorVersionSingleTokenTwo -count=1` reported major version 1 for Amazon release `2`.

## Implementation

- Added exact family/release lifecycle table and EOL evaluators in `config/os.go`, with OS family constants in the same file. `Ended` marks entries whose standard and extended end dates are the same; phase checks use strict `now.After` and treat absent extended dates as not applicable.
- Added per-target EOL warning evaluation in `scan`, using the supplied scan timestamp and normalizing detected patch releases only at the scan lookup boundary. `GetEOL` itself remains exact-key lookup.
- Summary prints each warning separately in evaluation order with `Warning: `.
- Shared major parser lives in `version`, with public `util.Major`; existing package callers delegate to it. The small `version` package avoids a `config`/`util` import cycle.

## Verification

- `GOPROXY=off go test ./config ./util ./scan ./report ./oval ./gost -count=1` passed before the final boundary test was added.
- A repeat of that command with the final boundary test passed (exit code 0).
- `git diff --check` passed.

+package config
+
+import "time"
+
+// EOL describes the end dates for an OS release's support phases.
+type EOL struct {
+	StandardSupportUntil time.Time
+	ExtendedSupportUntil time.Time
+	Ended                bool
+}
+
+// IsStandardSupportEnded reports whether standard support has ended.
+func (e EOL) IsStandardSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.StandardSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.StandardSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSuppportEnded reports whether extended support has ended.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+}
+
+func supportDate(s string) time.Time {
+	if s == "" {
+		return time.Time{}
+	}
+	d, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", s)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	return d
+}
+
+func lifecycle(standard, extended string) EOL {
+	return EOL{StandardSupportUntil: supportDate(standard), ExtendedSupportUntil: supportDate(extended), Ended: extended != "" && standard == extended}
+}
+
+var osEOL = map[string]map[string]EOL{
+	Amazon: {
+		"2018.03":   lifecycle("2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"),

+// GetEOL returns lifecycle dates for an exact OS family and release.

+package config
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func TestEOLLookupAndBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
+	e, found := GetEOL(Ubuntu, "14.04")
+	if !found || e.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != "2019-04-30" || e.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != "2024-04-30" {
+		t.Fatalf("unexpected EOL: %+v, %v", e, found)
+	}
+	if e.IsStandardSupportEnded(e.StandardSupportUntil) || !e.IsStandardSupportEnded(e.StandardSupportUntil.Add(time.Nanosecond)) {
+		t.Fatal("standard support boundary")
+	}
+	if e.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(e.ExtendedSupportUntil) || !e.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(e.ExtendedSupportUntil.Add(time.Nanosecond)) {
+		t.Fatal("extended support boundary")
+	}
+	if _, found := GetEOL(Ubuntu, "12.10"); found {
+		t.Fatal("unlisted release found")
+	}
+}
+
+func TestEOLMapping(t *testing.T) {
+	entries := []struct{ family, release, standard, extended string }{
+		{Amazon, "2018.03", "2023-06-30", "2023-06-30"}, {Amazon, "2 (Karoo)", "2025-06-30", ""},
+		{RedHat, "7", "2024-06-30", ""}, {RedHat, "8", "2029-05-31", ""}, {RedHat, "6", "2020-11-30", "2024-06-30"},
+		{CentOS, "7", "2024-06-30", ""}, {CentOS, "8", "2021-12-31", ""}, {CentOS, "6", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{Oracle, "7", "2024-06-30", ""}, {Oracle, "8", "2029-05-31", ""}, {Oracle, "6", "2021-03-31", "2022-03-31"},
+		{Ubuntu, "18.04", "2023-05-31", "2028-04-30"}, {Ubuntu, "14.04", "2019-04-30", "2024-04-30"}, {Ubuntu, "14.10", "2015-07-30", "2015-07-30"}, {Ubuntu, "21.04", "2022-01-30", ""},
+		{Debian, "9", "2022-06-30", ""}, {Debian, "10", "2024-06-30", ""}, {Debian, "8", "2020-06-30", "2020-06-30"},
+		{Alpine, "3.10", "2021-05-30", ""}, {Alpine, "3.11", "2021-11-30", ""}, {Alpine, "3.12", "2022-05-30", ""}, {Alpine, "3.9", "2020-11-30", "2020-11-30"},
+		{FreeBSD, "11", "2021-09-30", "2021-09-30"}, {FreeBSD, "12", "2023-12-31", ""}, {FreeBSD, "10", "2019-10-30", "2019-10-30"},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range entries {
+		e, found := GetEOL(tt.family, tt.release)
+		if !found || e.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != tt.standard || (tt.extended == "" && !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero()) || (tt.extended != "" && e.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02") != tt.extended) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: %+v, found %v", tt.family, tt.release, e, found)
+		}
+	}
+	for _, tt := range []struct{ family, release string }{{RedHat, "9"}, {CentOS, "9"}, {Oracle, "9"}, {Ubuntu, "12.10"}, {Debian, "11"}, {Alpine, "3.13"}} {
+		if _, found := GetEOL(tt.family, tt.release); found {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected mapping: %s %s", tt.family, tt.release)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestAmazonMajorVersionSingleTokenTwo(t *testing.T) {
+	got, err := (Distro{Family: Amazon, Release: "2"}).MajorVersion()
+	if err != nil || got != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("Amazon 2 major = %d, %v", got, err)
+	}
+}

new file mode 100644
index 0000000..761c17b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/scan/eol.go
@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+package scan
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/util"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/models"
+)
+
+func appendEOLWarnings(r *models.ScanResult, now time.Time) {
+	if r.Family == config.ServerTypePseudo || r.Family == config.Raspbian {
+		return
+	}
+	e, found := config.GetEOL(r.Family, r.Release)
+	if !found {
+		release := r.Release
+		switch r.Family {
+		case config.RedHat, config.CentOS, config.Oracle, config.Debian, config.FreeBSD:
+			release = util.Major(release)
+		case config.Ubuntu, config.Alpine:
+			parts := strings.Split(release, ".")
+			if len(parts) > 2 {
+				release = strings.Join(parts[:2], ".")
+			}
+		}
+		e, found = config.GetEOL(r.Family, release)
+	}
+	if !found {
+		r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'", r.Family, r.Release))
+		return
+	}
+	if e.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, "Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.")
+		if !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if e.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.", e.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+			}
+		}
+	} else if !now.AddDate(0, 3, 0).Before(e.StandardSupportUntil) {
+		r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s", e.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+	}
+}
diff --git a/scan/eol_test.go b/scan/eol_test.go

@@ -0,0 +1,70 @@
+package scan
+
+import (
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/models"
+)
+
+func TestAppendEOLWarnings(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		family, release, now string
+		want                 []string
+	}{
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.10", "2016-01-01", []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",
+			"Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.",
+		}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "18.04", "2024-01-01", []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",
+			"Extended support available until 2028-04-30. Check the vendor site.",
+		}},
+		{config.FreeBSD, "11", "2021-07-01", []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "12.10", "2024-01-01", []string{"Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: ubuntu Release: 12.10'"}},
+		{config.Raspbian, "10", "2024-01-01", nil},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		now, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", tt.now)
+		r := models.ScanResult{Family: tt.family, Release: tt.release}
+		appendEOLWarnings(&r, now)
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.Warnings, tt.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %v, want %v", tt.family, tt.release, r.Warnings, tt.want)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestAppendEOLWarningsNormalizesDetectedRelease(t *testing.T) {
+	now, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", "2025-01-01")
+	for _, tt := range []struct{ family, release string }{{config.RedHat, "7.9"}, {config.CentOS, "7.9"}, {config.Oracle, "7.9"}, {config.Debian, "10.13"}, {config.FreeBSD, "11.4-RELEASE"}, {config.Ubuntu, "18.04.6"}, {config.Alpine, "3.10.2"}} {
+		r := models.ScanResult{Family: tt.family, Release: tt.release}
+		appendEOLWarnings(&r, now)
+		if len(r.Warnings) == 0 || len(r.Warnings[0]) >= 19 && r.Warnings[0][:19] == "Failed to check EOL" {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: %v", tt.family, tt.release, r.Warnings)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestAppendEOLWarningsAtPhaseBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
+	end, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", "2021-09-30")
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		now  time.Time
+		want []string
+	}{
+		{end.AddDate(0, -3, 0).Add(-time.Nanosecond), nil},
+		{end.AddDate(0, -3, 0), []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{end, []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{end.Add(time.Nanosecond), []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",
+			"Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.",
+		}},
+	} {
+		r := models.ScanResult{Family: config.FreeBSD, Release: "11"}
+		appendEOLWarnings(&r, tt.now)
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.Warnings, tt.want) {
+			t.Errorf("at %s: got %v, want %v", tt.now, r.Warnings, tt.want)
+		}
+	}
+}

+// Package version contains shared version parsing primitives.
+package version
+
+import "strings"
+
+// Major returns the component before the first dot, after an optional epoch.
+func Major(value string) string {
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(value, ':'); i >= 0 {
+		value = value[i+1:]
+	}
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(value, '.'); i >= 0 {
+		return value[:i]
+	}
+	return value
+}

+package config
+
+import "time"
+
+// EOL describes the end dates for an OS release's support phases.
+type EOL struct {
+	StandardSupportUntil time.Time
+	ExtendedSupportUntil time.Time
+	Ended                bool
+}
+
+// IsStandardSupportEnded reports whether standard support has ended.
+func (e EOL) IsStandardSupportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.StandardSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.StandardSupportUntil)
+}
+
+// IsExtendedSuppportEnded reports whether extended support has ended.
+func (e EOL) IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now time.Time) bool {
+	return !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() && now.After(e.ExtendedSupportUntil)
+}
+
+func supportDate(s string) time.Time {
+	if s == "" {
+		return time.Time{}
+	}
+	d, err := time.Parse("2006-01-02", s)
+	if err != nil {
+		panic(err)
+	}
+	return d
+}
+
+func lifecycle(standard, extended string) EOL {
+	return EOL{StandardSupportUntil: supportDate(standard), ExtendedSupportUntil: supportDate(extended), Ended: extended != "" && standard == extended}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,47 @@
+package scan
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/util"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/config"
+	"github.com/future-architect/vuls/models"
+)
+
+func appendEOLWarnings(r *models.ScanResult, now time.Time) {
+	if r.Family == config.ServerTypePseudo || r.Family == config.Raspbian {
+		return
+	}
+	e, found := config.GetEOL(r.Family, r.Release)
+	if !found {
+		release := r.Release
+		switch r.Family {
+		case config.RedHat, config.CentOS, config.Oracle, config.Debian, config.FreeBSD:
+			release = util.Major(release)
+		case config.Ubuntu, config.Alpine:
+			parts := strings.Split(release, ".")
+			if len(parts) > 2 {
+				release = strings.Join(parts[:2], ".")
+			}
+		}
+		e, found = config.GetEOL(r.Family, release)
+	}
+	if !found {
+		r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: %s Release: %s'", r.Family, r.Release))
+		return
+	}
+	if e.IsStandardSupportEnded(now) {
+		r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, "Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.")
+		if !e.ExtendedSupportUntil.IsZero() {
+			if e.IsExtendedSuppportEnded(now) {
+				r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, "Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.")
+			} else {
+				r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Extended support available until %s. Check the vendor site.", e.ExtendedSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+			}
+		}
+	} else if !now.AddDate(0, 3, 0).Before(e.StandardSupportUntil) {
+		r.Warnings = append(r.Warnings, fmt.Sprintf("Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: %s", e.StandardSupportUntil.Format("2006-01-02")))
+	}
+}

+
+func TestAppendEOLWarnings(t *testing.T) {
+	tests := []struct {
+		family, release, now string
+		want                 []string
+	}{
+		{config.Ubuntu, "14.10", "2016-01-01", []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",
+			"Extended support is also EOL. There are many Vulnerabilities that are not detected, Upgrading your OS strongly recommended.",
+		}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "18.04", "2024-01-01", []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",
+			"Extended support available until 2028-04-30. Check the vendor site.",
+		}},
+		{config.FreeBSD, "11", "2021-07-01", []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{config.Ubuntu, "12.10", "2024-01-01", []string{"Failed to check EOL. Register the issue to https://github.com/future-architect/vuls/issues with the information in 'Family: ubuntu Release: 12.10'"}},
+		{config.Raspbian, "10", "2024-01-01", nil},
+	}
+	for _, tt := range tests {
+		now, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", tt.now)
+		r := models.ScanResult{Family: tt.family, Release: tt.release}
+		appendEOLWarnings(&r, now)
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(r.Warnings, tt.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s %s: got %v, want %v", tt.family, tt.release, r.Warnings, tt.want)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestAppendEOLWarningsNormalizesDetectedRelease(t *testing.T) {
+	now, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", "2025-01-01")
+	for _, tt := range []struct{ family, release string }{{config.RedHat, "7.9"}, {config.CentOS, "7.9"}, {config.Oracle, "7.9"}, {config.Debian, "10.13"}, {config.FreeBSD, "11.4-RELEASE"}, {config.Ubuntu, "18.04.6"}, {config.Alpine, "3.10.2"}} {

+		appendEOLWarnings(&r, now)

+			t.Errorf("%s %s: %v", tt.family, tt.release, r.Warnings)
+		}
+	}
+}
+
+func TestAppendEOLWarningsAtPhaseBoundaries(t *testing.T) {
+	end, _ := time.Parse("2006-01-02", "2021-09-30")
+	for _, tt := range []struct {
+		now  time.Time
+		want []string
+	}{
+		{end.AddDate(0, -3, 0).Add(-time.Nanosecond), nil},
+		{end.AddDate(0, -3, 0), []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{end, []string{"Standard OS support will be end in 3 months. EOL date: 2021-09-30"}},
+		{end.Add(time.Nanosecond), []string{
+			"Standard OS support is EOL(End-of-Life). Purchase extended support if available or Upgrading your OS is strongly recommended.",

+}

+// Package version contains shared version parsing primitives.
+package version
+
+import "strings"
+
+// Major returns the component before the first dot, after an optional epoch.
+func Major(value string) string {
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(value, ':'); i >= 0 {
+		value = value[i+1:]
+	}
+	if i := strings.IndexByte(value, '.'); i >= 0 {
+		return value[:i]
+	}
+	return value
+}
